text: the floor covers it thats not the problem in discussion the problem is that at a certain camera angle you can clearly see the green meaning the building is not even touching the ground
resolution: Continuation of the floors-float-above-ground investigation (req_2024). Confirmed via measurement: floors store at y=0 over height-0 ground (numerically coincident), and the only geometric gap is the 12mm faceSlabLift in pieceShapes.ts plateShapes which lifted the floor's solid core+sides off the ground with a disconnected bottom plate dangling below. Commit 1ba22d852 makes the solid core span from piece.y up so the slab's sides reach the ground — at a ~5deg grazing angle a 12mm under-edge gap exposes ~5in of green behind it, matching the report. Rejected the 'flush-top' tangent (user correctly pointed out a larger floor on top already covers the grass; the issue is the floor not touching the ground, i.e. the under-edge gap). Could not reproduce the exact grazing view headlessly (self-shot camera only frames a wide overview, not a ground-level angle); crafted-session repro baked 0 floors because pieces load from the world stream store, not the session file. Fix is in the bake, so editor loader pane + /compiled show it only after a re-Compile/re-bake of the map (their current view is a stale pre-fix gamefile). Asked the user to re-Compile and verify, or name the test map so its floor Y vs ground height can be read directly if a larger offset remains.
